summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`, referenced from package.json scripts.preinstall) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from GitHub releases at install time and uses it to execute a bundled 727 KB single-line obfuscated file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. The declared purpose of the package is a Vue regex-helper component, which has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque install-time payload. `math_init.js` uses string-array rotation (`WV8StW` shift routine), a large numeric literal table, and `_0x`-style identifiers throughout, rendering its behavior unreadable without deobfuscation. The loader (`setup.mjs`) itself uses the same `_0xXXXX` identifier scheme. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: installing a second JS runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload evades Node-based static scanners, and the payload runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
